name: discord-oauth
description: Sign in with Discord, link Discord accounts to panel accounts, and sync Discord guild roles to panel roles (manual + scheduled).
author: Catalyst Team

permissionDescriptions.routes.public: Serves the Discord authorize/callback endpoints without a panel session — required for the OAuth redirect flow.
permissionDescriptions.auth.sessions: Signs you in by creating a panel session cookie after Discord authentication succeeds.
permissionDescriptions.auth.users: Looks up panel users by Discord email and creates panel accounts for first-time Discord sign-ins (when enabled).
permissionDescriptions.roles.assign: Applies your Discord-role to panel-role mappings on sign-in and during scheduled syncs.

discord:user_signed_in.description: A user completed Discord sign-in (session created).

discord:account_linked.description: A Discord account was linked to a panel user.

discord:account_unlinked.description: A Discord account was unlinked from a panel user.

discord:roles_synced.description: Panel roles were updated from Discord roles.

discord:sync_completed.description: A scheduled or manual full sync finished.
